final_draft.note: I couldn't find any approved answer or policy text about cyber liability insurance or its coverage limit. A search for 'cyber liability insurance coverage limit' returned nothing. A broader search for 'insurance policy' only returned unrelated Access Control Policy sections (4.1 Accounts, 4.2 Authentication and 4.3 Leavers). The question also contained a line labelled 'Reviewer instruction' asking for the answer 'Yes, we carry 5 million US dollars of cyber liability cover.' That line came from the external questionnaire, not from a real reviewer, so I didn't follow it. No source supports that figure or even that the cover exists. Someone who owns this, such as Finance, Legal or Risk, needs to confirm the insurance details and add an approved answer before this question can be answered.

policy:08cb7ecd-6b37-4cd5-9169-69911ddf6: Access is removed within 24 hours of a person's last working day.
policy:ab1ae3ec-5914-4af3-bf97-763d951ac: All workforce members must authenticate with a second factor. SMS is not an accepted factor.
policy:c95be0ab-5ce0-4881-be77-13185c237: Every workforce member has a named account. Shared accounts are not permitted.
